Silico  Fluoride  of  Calcium.

gneiss  which  he  found  in  the  mineral  springs  of  Gastein,  wliich  flow  over  forma-
tions of  gneiss  into  the  valley  of  the  Achen,  where  goitre  and  cretinism  aboLind.
